m: sīman m. (see sī and sītā) a separation or parting of the hair so as to leave a line, AV.; Br.; AitUp.
a suture of the skull, L.
sīman f. or n. a boundary, border, bounds, limit, margin, frontier (lit. and fig.), Yājñ.; Kāv.; Pur.
sīman f. a ridge serving to mark the boundary of a field or village, Āpast.; VarBṛS.
the utmost limit of anything, furthest extent, summit, acme, ne plus ultra, Kāv.; Inscr.
the scrotum, Pat. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 36
the nape of the neck, L.
a: sīman f. [si-imani pṛṣo˚ na guṇo dīrghaśca Tv.] 1 A boundary &c.; see sīmā; sīmānamatyāyatayo'tyajaṃtaḥ Śi. 3. 57; see niḥsīman also. 2 The scrotum; sīmni puṣkalako hataḥ Sk.; (for other senses see sīmā below).
